steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Work on the auction stage before configuring it.
Apply the auction pricing template required for the bid sheet.
Add a product for Vendor A to quote.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the vendor specified by the case.
Publish the auction so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this event's auction bid sheet in the vendor portal.
Enter the requested quote and submit it from Vendor A's portal.
Assert that the vendor portal accepted the submitted bid.
Return to the buyer's event page to observe the live result.
Open the buyer comparison grid and verify Vendor A's bid is visible.
Assert that the submitted bid produces a live auction rank.
